r.국가 원수: Guillaume V, Grand Duke of Luxembourg
r.문화권·종교: Luxembourgish, French and German · Catholic tradition
r.주식시장 시가총액: $69.4 billion, 69% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.주요 수출품: Machinery, computers 12%, Plastics 11%, Vehicles, parts 10%, Iron and steel 8%, Steel products 6% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: LCD devices 28%, Plastics 15%, Industrial fabrics 10%, Phones, telecom equipment 9% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Copper 49%, Electronics, electrical equipment 13%, Valves 9%, Industrial machinery 7% (2025, share of value)

r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy and a founding member of the European Union.

t.why: A global financial center and home of the European Court of Justice.
t.rel: A small grand duchy between France, Germany and Belgium and a founding member of the EU. It is a financial center and home of the European Court of Justice.
t.korea: The least populous of the countries that fought in the Korean War.
t.know: In 2020 Luxembourg became the first country to make all public transport free.
t.etext: A European financial center full of funds and banks, giving it one of the highest incomes per person in the world. A steel company's headquarters and satellite communications firms are there too.
